card.name: Headings and table titles in labels
card.fires_on: Words inside section headings, table titles and capitalized warnings in drug labels, such as 'and' between two items or the middle of a long word. It is strongest in titles like 'Table 1. Amount of ...' or 'Recommended Dosage for ...'.

modes.label: Linking words in titles
modes.description: Small words like 'and', 'with' or 'on' inside a table title or heading.
modes.example: Table 1. Amount of Fibrinogen<< and>> Thrombin per Total Patch Size

modes.label: Partway through heading words
modes.description: The later part of a long word split up in a heading or all-caps warning.
modes.example: 2.2 Recommended Dosage for Relapsed or Refr<<actory>> Diffuse Large B‑cell Lymph

card.writes: It seems to suppress odd continuations and nudge toward short word-starting pieces, with no clear meaning.
card.plain: It lights up on connecting words and word middles in section headings and table titles of drug labels.
